faces.name: Mass of Mysteries
faces.oracleText:
First strike, vigilance, trample
At the beginning of combat on your turn, another target Elemental you control gains myriad until end of turn. (Whenever it attacks, for each opponent other than defending player, you may create a token copy that's tapped and attacking that player or a planeswalker they control. Exile the tokens at end of combat.)

faces.name: Mass Polymorph
faces.oracleText: Exile all creatures you control, then reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal that many creature cards. Put all creature cards revealed this way onto the battlefield, then shuffle the rest of the revealed cards into your library.

faces.name: Mass Production
faces.oracleText: Create four 1/1 colorless Soldier artifact creature tokens.
